options.reason: The table was assembled for survival analysis of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: 415 patients with one row each, 480 homogeneous tumour gene-expression features, plus follow-up time in months and a death event indicator. Modeling time-to-event from expression with the event column as censoring indicator matches the brief to derive a risk stratification and validate it on CPTAC.
